# Branding prompts

Tool: built-in image generation. The existing TableKit logo and social
preview were edit targets. The ts-expressor assets supplied the palette,
typography, background, and social-card style reference. The logo keeps its
transparent background and cutouts; the social card is exported as JPEG
without changing its generated 2:1 layout.

## Logo alignment

Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.

Edit the existing Laravel TableKit logo. Preserve the bold capital T, wide
rounded top bar, vertical stem, six transparent table-grid cutouts, balanced
proportions, and centered placement. Use the ts-expressor logo as the style
and palette reference. Match its professional blue `#28518D`, refine the
edges, and retain actual alpha transparency outside the mark and inside the
grid. Avoid additional shapes, lettering, gradients, shadows, or decoration.

## Social preview

Use case: style-transfer / ads-marketing.

Edit the existing 2:1 TableKit banner using the ts-expressor social card as
the authoritative color, typography, background, and layout reference.
Use the updated TableKit T-and-grid logo on the right. Match the cool-gray
`#EDF0F3` background, navy `#25313D` headings, blue `#28518D` accents,
pale-blue `#A8C7F5` subtitle panel, clean sans-serif typography, generous
margins, author label, and left-text/right-logo balance. Preserve this
TableKit copy:

- `THURA AUNG / OPEN SOURCE`
- `Laravel TableKit`
- `Laravel data tables`
- `Search · Filters · Actions`
- `Server-side tables`
- `github.com/thuraaung2493/laravel-tablekit`

Keep the design flat and uncluttered, with no extra logos, watermark,
or decorative background. The reference values guide the generated assets;
raster colors and typography are visually matched rather than pixel-identical.
